metadata.supervision_protocol: all matching-class source_train and all target_train labels visible
metadata.protocol_deviation: Fair-comparison adaptation uses all source/target labels and RGB/NIR/AIS inputs instead of the paper's source-free few-shot budget; the RGB TIR, CoOp and LoRA mechanisms are retained while the task-specific NIR/AIS heads use supervised minibatch optimization
metadata.training_update_semantics: NIR/AIS heads and gates update per minibatch; LoRA/CoOp take one gradient-averaged update per epoch, matching the released full-support CLIP update density
metadata.checkpoint_policy: in-memory best state; no model files retained
metadata.ais_input: heading sin/cos, length, and width into a directly supervised three-class MLP; validity mask is gating-only
metadata.image_input: 8-bit-semantics RGB scaling (/255 with sparse outlier clipping), CLIP normalization at 224x224; NIR uses an independent directly supervised convolutional classifier
metadata.fusion: confidence-calibrated convex probability fusion of RGB, NIR and AIS with softplus-positive trainable modal weights

normalization.rule: statistics fitted only on: source_train + target_train

metadata.augmentation: paired light random crop and horizontal/vertical flips
